helpIntro: Vanderbilt undergraduate GPA is credit-hour weighted on a 4.0 scale. Enter final grades and credit hours to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: A+ is used by Engineering and is worth 4.0. Pass, transfer, study-abroad, withdrawal, and temporary I/M work are excluded. Repeat Impact is disabled because repeat eligibility varies by school.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9; together, 21.9 ÷ 6 = 3.65.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F earns zero grade points and its credit hours count in GPA unless a valid repeat replacement applies.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass is excluded from the Vanderbilt GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is temporary and excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.M: Missed final examination is temporary and excluded until resolved.
